S.meta.title: Lewydo™ — Love What You Do · ƙaramin kamfanin wasanni daga Ukraine
S.meta.desc: Lewydo ƙaramin kamfanin wasanni ne na mutum biyu daga Ukraine. Vlad yana rubuta code, Lilya tana zane. Yi wasan CubePix da Orbit Dash a nan cikin wannan shafin, kuma ka samu duk wasanninmu a Google Play.

S.lang.title: Harshe
S.lang.none: Ba mu fara wannan harshen ba tukuna.
S.lang.stop: Rasha, ka daina yaƙi a Ukraine
S.hero.h1: Lewydo — ƙaramin kamfanin wasanni daga Ukraine
S.hero.lead: Mu ne Vlad da Lilya. **Vlad yana rubuta code, Lilya tana zane** — kuma tare muke yin wasannin da mu kanmu muke son yi.
S.hero.replay: Zuciyar Lewydo. Taɓa domin a sake haɗa ta
S.worlds.title: Kowane wasa duniya ce ta kansa
S.worlds.lead: Shigo ka yi wasa a nan: shafin yana canzawa tare da kowace duniya.
S.cp.next: Ka ji daɗi? Gidan tarihi cike da zane-zane yana jiranka a demo kyauta.
S.cp.aria: Ƙaramin wasan wuyar warwarewa na CubePix: cika akwatuna da lambar kubinka
S.od.tag: Da'ira biyu. Taɓawa ɗaya. Kowane tsalle a kan bugu.
S.od.lead: Wasan bugu a cikin sararin samaniya: taɓawa ɗaya tana canza da'ira, kuma kowane tsalle yana faɗowa a kan bugun kiɗanmu na kanmu. Matakai biyar, yanayin Ba Ƙarshe, Orbit III da jerin gwanaye na duniya.
S.od.new: Yanzu da **harsuna 82**. Wasan yana zaɓar harshen wayarka da kansa. Canza shi a kowane lokaci da duniya a cikin saituna.
S.od.offline: Ana yi ba tare da intanet ba
S.od.aria: Orbit Dash — ainihin wasan, kai tsaye
S.more.title: Ƙari daga Lewydo
S.more.lead: Wasan haɗawa mai sanyaya rai, wasan dannawa mai daɗi da jagororin hulɗa ga masu ƙirƙirar wasanni — duk a Google Play.
S.game.imc.d: Ja. Haɗa. Girma. Wasan haɗawa na idle mai sanyaya rai mai manufofi, ladan kullum da ci gaban kubai marar ƙarshe.
S.game.joints.d: Jagorar hulɗa kan haɗin Box2D a LibGDX, tare da misalai masu rai, motsin hoto da hanyoyin haɗi masu amfani. Mai ƙirƙirar LibGDX ne ya yi ta don masu ƙirƙirar LibGDX.
S.game.light.d: Yi wasa da nau'ikan haske 2D guda huɗu: maki, mazugi, sarƙa da mai alkibla. Matsar da fitilu, ƙirƙiri inuwa ka gyara kowane saiti.
S.game.autumn.d: Wasan dannawa na kaka da ganyayen da ke faɗuwa, launuka masu ɗumi, sautukan yanayi da za a buɗe da jerin gwanaye. Babu agogo, babu matsi: kawai taɓa ka huta.
S.studio.title: Mutum biyu, zuciya ɗaya
S.cd.title: Vlad yana rubuta code. Lilya tana zane.
S.cd.text: Ja maɓallin zamewa: haka ake haifar kowane wasan Lewydo — daga code ɗin Vlad zuwa zanen Lilya.
S.brand.more: Alamar Lewydo: zuciya, bugunta da kayan aiki
S.p.vlad.who: Vlad, mai ƙirƙirar Android da LibGDX · yankin Poltava, Ukraine
S.p.vlad.bio: Yana rubuta code tun 2017: farko Java, bayan shekara ɗaya Kotlin. Tun 2021 mai ƙirƙirar wasanni ne na cikakken lokaci, daga mai koyon aiki har zuwa Team Lead a kamfanin wasanni. Kowane wasan Lewydo an gina shi da Kotlin da LibGDX, farko don Android.
S.p.lilya.who: Liliia, mai zanen yanar gizo da UX/UI
S.p.lilya.bio: Shafukan yanar gizo, zanen gabatarwa da hotunan kafofin sada zumunta su ne babban aikinta. Saboda Vlad ta shiga zanen wasanni ma, kuma kowane wasan Lewydo yana da tasirinta. *A tsakaninmu: shafukan yanar gizo har yanzu su ne soyayyarta ta farko* 😉
S.story.title: Labarinmu zuwa yanzu
S.story.1.d: Vlad ya rubuta code ɗinsa na farko. Bayan shekara ɗaya ya koma Kotlin kuma ya zauna da ita har abada.
S.story.2.d: Vlad ya bar Cibiyar Sojoji ta Sadarwa ya shiga wasanni na cikakken lokaci: mai koyon aiki, junior… har zuwa Team Lead.
S.story.3.d: Mai ƙirƙira ya haɗu da mai zane. Kamfanin bai san yana nan ba tukuna.
S.story.4.d: Rana ɗaya, wata daban — ƙungiya har abada.
S.story.brand.d: Vlad koyaushe yana ƙare rubuce-rubucensa na [Medium](https://veldan1202.medium.com/) game da LibGDX, Android da Kotlin a hanya ɗaya: «Love what you do» da zuciya kore 💚. Wannan sa hannun ya zama alamarmu.
S.story.imc.d: IMC: Idle Merge Cubes 2026 ya fito a Google Play.
S.story.idea.d: Vlad yana aiki a Rundunar Sojojin Ukraine. Wata safiya ya farka a gidan da rukuninsa ke zaune lokacin wani aiki — da ra'ayin CubePix a kansa.
S.story.od.d: Mun ƙirƙiri Orbit Dash muka fitar da shi a Google Play: da'ira biyu, taɓawa ɗaya.
S.story.proto.d: Samfurin farko da za a iya wasa: shahararrun zane-zane suna bayyana kubi bayan kubi.
S.story.pix.d: Mun zana alamar CubePix: ƙaramin kubi ruwan hoda, mai zane da hular beret da burushi. Sunansa Pix — Cube + Pix = CubePix, don haka wasan yana ɗauke da sunansa.
S.story.live.t: Orbit Dash kai tsaye a TikTok
S.story.live.d: Andrii (TikTok @malcev_ua) yana buga Orbit Dash a TikTok LIVE — mai yaɗa kai tsaye na farko da ya yi live da wasanmu.
S.story.live.video: Andrii yana buga Orbit Dash kai tsaye a TikTok (bidiyo na daƙiƙa 21)
S.story.live.thanks: Na gode, Andrii, da kasancewarka mai yaɗa kai tsaye na farko da ya yi live yana buga wasana. Na gode ƙwarai da gaske!
S.story.next.d: Yana zuwa wannan watan — ainihin rana nan ba da jimawa ba.
S.contact.title: Mu yi wani abu da za ka so
S.contact.text: Kana da ra'ayin haɗin gwiwa mai ban sha'awa, ko kana buƙatar wasa mai inganci? Rubuta mana — za mu yi farin cikin jin daga gare ka.
S.foot.made: An yi da 💚 a yankin Poltava, Ukraine 🇺🇦
S.nf.title: Wannan shafin ya ɓace
S.nf.text: Wataƙila an motsa shi, ko akwai kuskuren rubutu a hanyar haɗin. Duk abin da muke yi yana kan babban shafi.

S.od.levels: Wannan shi ne ainihin wasan. Taɓa allon ka yi matakin da kanka.
S.cp:lead: Wasan wuyar warwarewa mai natsuwa ga masu son fasaha. Cika kubobi shafi bayan shafi, sai shahararrun zane-zane, al'ajaban duniya da ƙananan taskokin pixel su samu rai. Kowane hoto yana ƙarewa da katin bayani na gidan tarihi da labari na gaskiya.
S.cp:about: Lewydo ƙaramin kamfanin wasanni ne na mutum biyu daga Ukraine. Vlad yana rubuta code, Lilya tana zayyana. Tare muna yin wasannin da mu kanmu muke son yi.
S.cp:how: Kubinka yana nuna lamba. Taɓa murabba'ai masu lamba iri ɗaya, ko ka ja yatsa a kansu cikin doguwar sarƙa ɗaya: sarƙoƙi suna ba da ƙarin maki.
S.cp:demo: Zane daga gidan tarihi, ana bayyana shi shafi bayan shafi
S.cp:pixName: Shi kubi ne (cube), sunansa kuma Pix. Haɗa su biyu za ka sami CubePix: wasan yana ɗauke da sunansa.

strawberry.f: Strawberry ba ainihin berry ba ne: kowace ƙaramar “ƙwaya” a jikinsa ɗan itace ne daban mai iri a ciki.
